criteria.requirement: The provider is invoked for each parse and must return a fresh open readable stream. Two supplied parses yield2 then3 and the parser closes both streams; reusing a closed stream is not valid. Validate the full new configuration before an explicit application-owned publication/recovery boundary and define provider errors/reload serialization. The parser does not itself atomically publish live application state or fetch an unspecified secret service.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
